summary: Fresh-restore smoke test of the RUBIN PHP casino. Everything requested PASSES. Home (mobile + desktop): RUBIN brand, banner carousel (3 slides + dots), 'Оригинальные игры' cards and bottom nav (Главная/Игры/Депозит/Бонусы/Рефералы) all render. Login with tst465641/Test12345 works through the modal, and the session survives a reload. Registering a new user (TESTr30712) logged that user in, the session survived a reload, and the header showed 0.00 ₽. /dice /mines /bubbles /x50 /bonus /me /ref /slot load for a logged-in user with no PHP errors. A 1 ₽ dice bet returned a result from action.php and the balance went from 991 to 990. /admin while logged out shows the admin login form; logging in through it opens the dashboard. /admin/users, rtp, slots, promo, find and slotpromo all load. POST /api/slots/callback returns the JSON {ok:false, error:'server_misconfigured'} with HTTP 500, which is expected while SLOTS_API_SECRET/WGC_API_KEY are not set. The new pytest smoke suite passed 19/19.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 with server_misconfigured because SLOTS_API_SECRET/WGC_API_KEY are not set (EXPECTED until the keys are added; restart frontend afterwards so PHP picks up the env)

ui_bugs.issue: Console pageerrors: 'ClipboardJS is not defined' (script/script.js), 'Cannot read properties of null (reading setAttribute)' on /, 'chatc is not defined' (ajax/func.js uses an undefined chatc var), and 'no supported source' audio on /dice. None of them break any flow.

action_items: None blocking. When the user provides keys: set SLOTS_API_SECRET, WGC_API_KEY, CRYPTOBOT_TOKEN, XROCKET_TOKEN and restart frontend (PHP reads the process env)
Optional (LOW): fix the legacy JS errors (ClipboardJS, chatc)
critical_code_review_comments: action.php builds SQL by string interpolation ($login, $user_id...) in many places, which is a SQL injection risk. This is legacy code left as-is per the user's request.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_rubin_restore_smoke.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. MySQL CLI: /app/casino/.runtime/mysql/bin/mysql --socket=/app/casino/mysql-run/mysql.sock -u root beezename. To log in, POST /action.php with type=login. On mobile the header 'Регистрация' button is visible but the modal tab with the same text is hidden, so use the locator visible=true. Admin login form uses data-testid admin-login-input/admin-password-input/admin-login-submit. The WGC tests in test_rubin_wgc_callback.py need SLOTS_API_SECRET and were not run.
